rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: User reported exchange_closed triggered after missing only 2/3 cycles due to API inconsistency/rate limits. The previous debounce (3 cycles) was not strong enough.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: (1) Added exchange_closed_require_closed_pnl=true to require actual closed PnL records as evidence, (2) Added exchange_closed_force_cycles=8 as fallback threshold, (3) _can_finalize_exchange_closed now checks: closed_records>0 OR missing_cycles>=force_cycles
rca_of_the_issue.verification: With new logic, position missing for 3 cycles but no closed PnL records will NOT be finalized. Must either have closed records OR wait 8 cycles for forced reconciliation.
